name: Genjutsu (Creative Coding & Multi-Agent Framework)
purpose: Multi-agent creative coding framework for Claude Code/claude.ai spanning web, SwiftUI, and Jetpack Compose.
capabilities: Full design system and branding generation (paint)

installation.instructions: Not installed in workspace. Blocked due to redundancy with GSAP AI skills, motion-design, and high subagent token overhead.

compatibility.notes: Designed for Claude Code plugin and claude.ai environment. Lacks HyperFrames, Kokoro TTS, or deterministic video assembly integration.

licensing.notes: MIT licensed open-source framework by AThevon.

security.notes: Bunshin workflow spawns autonomous subagents running arbitrary shell commands and consuming millions of tokens over hours.

approval_evidence: Formal Workspace Steward evaluation on 2026-10-30: Rejected/Blocked. Genjutsu overlaps 100% with existing workspace skills (gsap-skills, motion-design, motion-graphics-designer) and introduces excessive token complexity (10.5M tokens/run) with zero support for the repository's deterministic video rendering pipeline.
